config.title: CI/CD pipelines

intro.title: CI/CD pipelines
intro.body: In this lesson, you will build a simple CI/CD pipeline that automatically runs tests and deploys a basic application. You will learn the core concept of automating software delivery through continuous integration and continuous deployment. The main technologies involved include a version control system (like Git), a CI/CD tool (such as GitHub Actions), and a deployment target (like a static web server). By the end, you will understand how to set up a pipeline that triggers on code changes, runs checks, and ensures reliable releases.
intro.usecase: CI/CD pipelines are the backbone of modern software delivery, powering every update you see in applications like Netflix, Amazon, or GitHub. Developers interact with these pipelines through dedicated dashboards that visualize build status, test results, and deployment stages. When you submit a pull request on GitHub, automated pipelines run tests and checks before merging. In production engineering, these pipelines enable teams to deploy hundreds of times daily while maintaining reliability through automated quality gates and rollback mechanisms.

objectives: Configure a basic CI/CD pipeline for a sample application
Implement automated testing stages within a CI/CD workflow
Construct deployment scripts for staging and production environments
Integrate version control triggers with pipeline execution
Manipulate pipeline configuration to handle different branching strategies
Initialize monitoring and alerting for pipeline failures
Apply security scanning tools within the CI/CD process
